cards.card_text: True or false: three days after the treaty, Israel learns the Gibeonites really do live in a very distant land.
cards.verse_text: Three days after they had made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites learned that they were neighbors, living among them.
cards.snippet: Three days after they had made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites learned that they were neighbors, living among them.

cards.card_text: Then Joshua summons the Gibeonites: “Why did you deceive us by telling us you live far away from us, when in fact you live among us?”
cards.verse_text: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, “Why did you deceive us by telling us you live far away from us, when in fact you live among us?

cards.card_text: Then the Gibeonites answer: they were told the LORD commanded Moses to give Israel all the land and wipe out all its inhabitants.

cards.card_text: The Gibeonites put themselves in Joshua's hands.
cards.verse_text: So Joshua did this and delivered them from the hands of the Israelites, and they did not kill the Gibeonites.
cards.snippet: …from the hands of the Israelites, and they did not kill the Gibeonites.

cards.card_text: Blood Saul shed killing the Gibeonites Idols the people set up in the land Sheba's revolt against King David
cards.verse_text: And the LORD said, “It is because of the blood shed by Saul and his family, because he killed the Gibeonites.”
cards.snippet: …the blood shed by Saul and his family, because he killed the Gibeonites.”

cards.card_text: So David calls in the Gibeonites, who aren't Israelites but what's left of the Amorites.
cards.verse_text: At this, David summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them.
cards.snippet: At this, David summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them.

cards.card_text: Saul kept the oath Israel had taken concerning the Gibeonites.
cards.verse_text: At this, David summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them.

cards.card_text: David calls in the Gibeonites because of the famine.
cards.verse_text: So David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you?
cards.snippet: So David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you?

cards.card_text: The Gibeonites say they need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, and David shouldn't put anyone in Israel to death for them.

cards.card_text: The Gibeonites turn down silver and gold from Saul's house.
cards.verse_text: The Gibeonites said to him, “We need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, nor should you put to death anyone in Israel for us.” “Whatever you ask, I will do for you,” he replied.

cards.card_text: David delivers the seven into the hands of the Gibeonites.
cards.verse_text: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill before the LORD.
cards.snippet: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill before the LORD.

cards.card_text: One standout is Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty, a band of David's mighty men, and a leader over the Thirty.
cards.verse_text: Ahiezer their chief and Joash, who were the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite; Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite; Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite; Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites; and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
